SOURCE of occurrences.parquet - real OBIS occurrence rows (fixture for the plankton import tests)

Only CC-BY / CC0 datasets; redistributed in the public mirror under those licences with attribution below.
Each licence was verified from the OBIS dataset metadata field `intellectualrights` (datasets.json, as returned
by https://api.obis.org/v3/dataset/<id>); licenses.tsv is only a fallback and holds ONLY the rows that exist in
the OBIS licence dump (it misses the CPR Survey and the Australian Microbiome - nothing was invented).

Retrieved: 2026-10-03 (selection run on the VPS with DuckDB 1.5.6 over httpfs).
Raw column layout kept exactly as in the OBIS S3 files (select *, no renaming): _id, _event_id, _occurrence_id,
dataset_id, node_ids, source, interpreted, extensions, missing, invalid, flags, dropped, absence, tags, geometry.
Rows: 228, 4 datasets. Rows were chosen BY CONDITION (see the query), deterministic: order by hash(_id||category).

Source URLs (one parquet per dataset, https://obis-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/occurrence/<dataset_id>.parquet):

Categories NOT available in CC-BY/CC0 data (cover them synthetically in unit tests):
  - depth min/max ONLY (interpreted.depth NULL while min and max depth set): 0 rows in every open dataset of the
    OBIS extract (OBIS derives interpreted.depth whenever a min/max exists). Rows with a depth RANGE (min<>max)
    and a depth value are present (CPR, cd42b44b).
  - month outside 1..12 ("13"): none. interpreted."month" is NULL for the CPR and the Australian Microbiome; the
    only populated months are in 8726cede (28 rows) and cd42b44b (18 rows).
  - dinoflagellate/diatom/coccolithophore/euphausiacea ABSENCE rows: the only absence=true rows in the chosen
    datasets are copepods (8726cede).
  - no row has copepods with a NULL order outside the CPR.
  - Copepoda at SUBCLASS rank (interpreted.subclass = 'Copepoda'): 0 rows. All 97 copepod rows have
    class = 'Copepoda'. None of the four datasets has subclass-ranked copepods (checked in the OBIS extract too:
    0 rows) -> covered by a synthetic unit test in Task 7.

WARNING (eDNA rule): the CPR Survey rows carry extensions."http://rs.gbif.org/terms/1.0/DNADerivedData" as an
EMPTY LIST, not NULL (verified on the first 20 000 raw CPR rows: 20 000 not null, 0 with len>0). The rule
`DNADerivedData IS NOT NULL` therefore marks every CPR row as eDNA. Use
`coalesce(len(extensions."http://rs.gbif.org/terms/1.0/DNADerivedData"), 0) > 0` (Australian Microbiome: 80/80 true;
CPR 0/98; 8726cede and cd42b44b: NULL).

Query (DuckDB; per dataset: step 1 choose _id per category from the raw file, step 2 copy `select *` for those _id;
then `select * from part_*.parquet order by dataset_id,_id` -> occurrences.parquet, zstd). The category predicates
and the per-dataset row quotas (PLAN) are verbatim below (the script is the text that was executed; its CPR PLAN
has the typo key `prym_phaseo=0`, which was a no-op: quota 0 and not in CATS, so it was skipped - the real
Prymnesiales/Phaeocystales quota is `prym_phaeo=4`); `\x27` is a single quote in the Python source.
```python
import duckdb,sys,time
B="https://obis-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/occurrence/"
KEPT="(\x27Microsetella\x27,\x27Macrosetella\x27,\x27Miracia\x27,\x27Euterpina\x27,\x27Clytemnestra\x27,\x27Aegisthus\x27)"
COP="(i.\"class\"=\x27Copepoda\x27 or i.subclass=\x27Copepoda\x27)"
CATS={
 "copepoda_other":f"{COP} and i.\"order\" is not null and i.\"order\" not in (\x27Harpacticoida\x27,\x27Siphonostomatoida\x27,\x27Monstrilloida\x27) and not absence and not dropped",
 "copepoda_null_order":f"{COP} and i.\"order\" is null and not absence and not dropped",
 "harp_kept_genus":f"{COP} and i.\"order\"=\x27Harpacticoida\x27 and i.genus in {KEPT}",
 "harp_other_genus":f"{COP} and i.\"order\"=\x27Harpacticoida\x27 and i.genus is not null and i.genus not in {KEPT}",
 "harp_null_genus":f"{COP} and i.\"order\"=\x27Harpacticoida\x27 and i.genus is null",
 "sipho_monstrilloid":f"{COP} and i.\"order\" in (\x27Siphonostomatoida\x27,\x27Monstrilloida\x27)",
 "euphausiacea":"i.\"order\"=\x27Euphausiacea\x27 and not absence and not dropped",
 "diatoms":"(i.phylum=\x27Bacillariophyta\x27 or i.division=\x27Bacillariophyta\x27 or i.\"class\" in (\x27Bacillariophyceae\x27,\x27Coscinodiscophyceae\x27,\x27Mediophyceae\x27)) and not absence and not dropped",
 "dinoflagellates":"(i.\"class\"=\x27Dinophyceae\x27 or \x27Dinoflagellata\x27 in (i.phylum,i.division,i.subphylum,i.infraphylum)) and not absence and not dropped",
 "coccolithophores":"i.\"class\" in (\x27Coccolithophyceae\x27,\x27Prymnesiophyceae\x27) and coalesce(i.\"order\",\x27\x27) not in (\x27Prymnesiales\x27,\x27Phaeocystales\x27) and not absence and not dropped",
 "prym_phaeo":"i.\"order\" in (\x27Prymnesiales\x27,\x27Phaeocystales\x27) and i.\"class\" in (\x27Coccolithophyceae\x27,\x27Prymnesiophyceae\x27)",
 "absence":"absence",
 "dropped":"dropped",
 "on_land":"list_contains(flags,\x27ON_LAND\x27)",
 "no_eventdate":"i.eventDate is null",
 "neg_depth":"i.depth<0",
 "range_depth":"i.minimumDepthInMeters<>i.maximumDepthInMeters",
 "any":"true",
}
PLAN={
 "5c4667b8-8d93-4768-bc7e-3c31cde1cf18":dict(copepoda_other=12,copepoda_null_order=5,harp_kept_genus=5,harp_other_genus=3,harp_null_genus=2,sipho_monstrilloid=3,euphausiacea=12,diatoms=12,dinoflagellates=12,coccolithophores=6,prym_phaseo=0,prym_phaeo=4,dropped=3,on_land=4,any=15),
 "b508f7bc-8708-43d5-b940-e44f2765d1af":dict(copepoda_other=8,harp_kept_genus=4,harp_other_genus=3,sipho_monstrilloid=2,euphausiacea=2,diatoms=10,dinoflagellates=10,coccolithophores=12,prym_phaeo=4,dropped=3,on_land=3,no_eventdate=4,any=15),
 "8726cede-98ab-4c06-859d-ce997e8f9717":dict(absence=10,harp_kept_genus=4,harp_other_genus=4,dropped=3,on_land=3,copepoda_other=0,any=8),
 "cd42b44b-2560-450d-88e7-70b5778d0194":dict(neg_depth=5,range_depth=5,euphausiacea=3,copepoda_null_order=3,any=5),
}
c=duckdb.connect(); c.execute("install httpfs; load httpfs; set memory_limit=\x27800MB\x27; set threads=1; set temp_directory=\x27work/tmp\x27")
only=sys.argv[1]
for n,(ds,p) in enumerate(PLAN.items()):
    if ds!=only: continue
    t=time.time(); url=f"{B}{ds}.parquet"
    c.execute(f"create temp table k as select _id,interpreted i0 ,flags,absence,dropped from (select _id,interpreted,flags,absence,dropped from read_parquet(\x27{url}\x27))")
    ids=set()
    for cat,k in p.items():
        if not k or cat not in CATS: continue
        r=c.execute(f"select _id from (select _id,i0 as i,flags,absence,dropped from k) where {CATS[cat]} order by hash(_id||\x27{cat}\x27) limit {k}").fetchall()
        print(ds[:8],cat,len(r),flush=True); ids|={x[0] for x in r}
    c.execute("create temp table want(id varchar)"); c.executemany("insert into want values(?)",[(x,) for x in ids])
    c.execute(f"copy (select * from read_parquet(\x27{url}\x27) where _id in (select id from want)) to \x27part_{ds[:8]}.parquet\x27 (format parquet, compression zstd)")
    print(ds[:8],"rows",c.execute(f"select count(*) from \x27part_{ds[:8]}.parquet\x27").fetchall(),round(time.time()-t),flush=True)
```
